description: This file defines the RowRange class, which models a range of rows in a spreadsheet, including methods for shifting, converting to cell ranges, and representing the range as a string.

classes.name: RowRange
classes.description: A class representing a range of rows in a spreadsheet, providing methods to manipulate, generate, and display row ranges.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates a RowRange instance from an array of two integers [from, to] and an optional worksheet.

methods.name: validateFromTo
methods.description: Validates and assigns the from and to row indices, ensuring from is less than or equal to to.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Returns the starting row of the range.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Returns the ending row of the range.

methods.name: rowCount
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total number of rows in the range.

methods.name: shiftRight
methods.description: Shifts the row range to the right by a specified offset, returning a new RowRange instance.

methods.name: shiftLeft
methods.description: Shifts the row range to the left by a specified offset, returning a new RowRange instance.

methods.name: toCellRange
methods.description: Converts the row range into a CellRange object spanning from the first to the last row.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the row range, optionally including the worksheet title.
